# Berkeley Nucleonics

> Precision test, measurement, and nuclear instrumentation, engineered and built in the United States since 1963. Eight instrument lines spanning timing, signal generation, waveform synthesis, radiation detection, isotope identification, high-power pulsing, spectrum analysis, and high-voltage power.

## Product lines
- [Pulse & Delay Generators](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/pdg-home.html): Digital delay and pulse generators, femtosecond to multi-channel timing.
- [RF & Microwave Signal Generators & Sensors](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/rfsg-home.html): Signal and vector sources plus USB RF power sensors.
- [Scintillation Detectors (ScintIQ)](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/scintiq-home.html): Spectroscopy-grade scintillator crystals and detectors.
- [Arbitrary Waveform Generators](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/awg-home.html): Deep-memory, high-fidelity arbitrary waveform generation.
- [Isotope ID & Radiation Detection](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/riid-home.html): Handheld and lab radioisotope identifiers and detectors.
- [High Power / Current Pulsers (DEI)](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/dei-home.html): High-voltage and high-current pulse generators.
- [ICX-FieldHawk Spectrum Analyzers](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/rtsa-home.html): Real-time handheld and rugged spectrum analyzers.
- [HVX High Voltage Power Supplies](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/hvx-home.html): Programmable high-voltage DC supplies.
- [BNC Scientific Partner Lines](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/bnc-scientific.html): Partner instrument lines represented in North America.

## Learning resources
- [Free Engineering Web Books](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/books/index.html): Free web books on precision timing, arbitrary waveforms, RF and microwave, RF power measurements, real-time spectrum analysis, radar, quantum computing, high-power pulse techniques, and RIIDs for hazmat response.
- [BNC Academy free course access](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/academy-free-access.html): Request free registration to a BNC Academy course; access codes delivered by text.
- [Press Room](https://www.berkeleynucleonics.com/docs/press-room.html): Company news, product announcements, and application articles.
